about: Pass 7 batch D (2026-10-09): 12 openly licensed speech-to-text sources whose own-model rows were alone in their runs (lone-batch-D.json, 69 lone rows). For each lone row, the same table's comparator columns were checked for evidence that the authors measured them under the same setup. Candidate rows only; data/ was not edited. Merge: results via npm run import (no new ledger ids: every row reuses the existing source_id and its exact pinned URL; the ledger scope/quote text of the card2-* entries says 'competitor columns are not used' and should be reworded as listed in the .md). No models, benchmarks or ledger entries are proposed. Counted-result effect simulated with lib/score.ts toCells on a scratch copy of data/ (import of the 17 rows): 12,299 -> 12,324.

checked.outcome: 17 lab rows: distil-large-v3 on the 7 short-form sets (Short-Form Evaluation table, column 'distil-v3') and distil-large-v2 + distil-large-v3 on the 5 long-form sets (Long-Form Evaluation table, columns 'distil-v2'/'distil-v3'). Same-family columns by the HF Distil-Whisper team, not marked as copied. Each of the 12 lone runs gets 2 (short-form) or 3 (long-form) models. Simulated with lib/score.ts toCells on a scratch copy: 10 of the 12 existing distil-v3.5 rows and 15 of the 17 new rows count (counted results 12,299 -> 12,324); ami-wer and earnings22-wer stay uncounted because those tests still have only 2 models across counting runs (MIN_MODELS = 3) - they would count if the Whisper columns or the NVIDIA pooling below are accepted. Whisper large-v3 / large-v3-turbo columns NOT used: the only setup sentences are about 'the model' ('We've evaluated the model on 5 in-distribution ... as done in Open ASR Leaderboard'; long-form 'We've evaluated the model ... using the sequential decoding algorithm'), with no statement that the OpenAI baselines were run by the authors; the short-form large-v3/large-v3-turbo cells are identical to the Open ASR Leaderboard CSV (e.g. large-v3 AMI 15.95, LS Clean 2.01, Earnings22 11.29 = openai/whisper-large-v3 in en_shortform.csv @16743c6). Held for owner (see held_for_owner). Rel. RTFx, RTFx table and the 'Short-Form OOD WER' 2-set average (no matching benchmark id) not used.

held_for_owner.reason: OpenAI Whisper comparator columns with no statement of who evaluated them. Short-form table columns 'large-v3' and 'large-v3-turbo' are digit-for-digit the Open ASR Leaderboard CSV values (en_shortform.csv @16743c6: whisper-large-v3 AMI 15.95, Gigaspeech 10.02, LS Clean 2.01, LS Other 3.91, Tedlium 3.86, Earnings22 11.29, SPGISpeech 2.94; turbo 16.13/10.14/2.10/4.24/3.57/11.63/2.97), i.e. leaderboard numbers.
